# Cerbos

> Cerbos is a policy-as-code authorization platform that provides fine-grained access control for enterprise software, AI systems, and multi-tenant applications.

Cerbos offers a comprehensive authorization solution through multiple products (Hub, PDP, Synapse) designed for Zero Trust architectures and AI-powered systems. The platform uses declarative policies to enforce consistent access control across applications, APIs, and infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- Authorization
- Policy-as-Code
- Fine-Grained Access Control
- Cerbos Hub
- Zero Trust
- Multi-Tenant SaaS
- AI Agent Authorization
- RBAC/ABAC/PBAC
- Policy Decision Point
- Enterprise Security
- RAG Authorization
- MCP Servers
- Cerbos PDP
- Policy Management
- Non-Human Identities

## Core Products

- [Cerbos Hub: Future-Proof Authorization, Built for Scale](https://www.cerbos.dev/product-cerbos-hub): Fine-grained contextual authorization across apps, APIs, and AI agents
- [Cerbos Synapse](https://www.cerbos.dev/product-synapse): Connect APIs and infrastructure for consistent authorization decisions
- [How It Works](https://www.cerbos.dev/how-it-works): How Cerbos integrates into applications and authorization workflows
- [Cerbos Ecosystem: Integrations, SDKs and Deployment Options](https://www.cerbos.dev/features-benefits-and-use-cases/ecosystem): Cerbos integrations, SDKs, and deployment options across frameworks

## AI and Modern Architecture

- [AI Agent Authorization & Access Control for Agentic Systems](https://www.cerbos.dev/features-benefits-and-use-cases/agentic-authorization): Cerbos AI agent authorization for deterministic, bounded, revocable access
- [Permissions-Aware Authorization for RAG Pipelines](https://www.cerbos.dev/features-benefits-and-use-cases/access-control-for-rag): Cerbos enforces user-level permissions at RAG retrieval layer
- [Enterprise-Grade Authorization for MCP Servers](https://www.cerbos.dev/features-benefits-and-use-cases/dynamic-authorization-for-MCP-servers): Cerbos centralized authorization layer for MCP server tools and AI capabilities

## Use Cases and Features

- [Multi-Tenant SaaS With Cerbos](https://www.cerbos.dev/features-benefits-and-use-cases/multi-tenant-saas): Multi-tenant SaaS authorization with policy-enforced tenant isolation
- [Personalized Access Control for Every SaaS Tenant](https://www.cerbos.dev/features-benefits-and-use-cases/per-tenant-custom-policies): Dynamic tenant-specific policies for multi-tenant SaaS
- [Application Permissions With Cerbos](https://www.cerbos.dev/features-benefits-and-use-cases/application-permissions): Context-aware, fine-grained access control for application permissions
- [Dynamic Policy Management at Scale](https://www.cerbos.dev/features-benefits-and-use-cases/dynamic-policies): Automated policy creation and deployment at scale
- [Scalable NHI Permission Management](https://www.cerbos.dev/features-benefits-and-use-cases/authorization-non-human-identities): Policy-driven authorization for workloads, microservices, and AI agents
